reminder.notes:
# Reminder 2.30.2 - Launcher Icon Monochrome & Dynamic Theme Support

### Features
- Added monochrome adaptive icon layer to `launcher_icon.xml` matching `android:roundIcon` and `android:icon`, ensuring seamless tinting with wallpaper dynamic palettes and dark mode on Android 13-17.

### Bug fixes
- Fixed reminder app keeping legacy icon on devices using circular launchers.

mirrordrive.notes:
# MirrorDrive 1.1.2 - Themed Icon & Round Launcher Alignment

### Features
- Unified adaptive icon and round launcher configurations with monochrome themed icon support for Android 13-17.

### Bug fixes
- Fixed launcher icon alignment and round launcher caching on newer Android versions.

twinclean.notes:
# TwinClean 1.5.2 - Themed Icon & Round Launcher Support

### Features
- Added explicit round icon declaration (`android:roundIcon`) and synced monochrome adaptive icon layer for Android 13-17 launchers.

### Bug fixes
- Fixed launcher icon not updating on circular launcher environments.

taashclub.notes:
# Taash Club 1.21.2 - Transparent Themed Icon Support

### Features
- Isolated playing card monochrome silhouette with transparent background for Android 13-17 Material You dynamic theme and dark mode.

### Bug fixes
- Fixed themed launcher icon rendering solid green table background.

cards.notes:
# Cards 2.7.2 - Transparent Themed Icon & Round Launcher Support

### Features
- Added pure transparent monochrome adaptive icon layer, ensuring the card emblem renders cleanly on Android 13-17 Material You wallpaper themes and dark mode without solid background fill.
- Added explicit round icon support (`android:roundIcon`) for circular launcher environments.

### Bug fixes
- Fixed launcher icon rendering solid square on themed home screens.

mailkeep.notes:
# Mailkeep 0.3.9 - Round Launcher & Full Folder Selection

### Features
- Added explicit round icon declaration (`android:roundIcon`) and synced monochrome adaptive icon layer for Android 13-17 launchers.
- Added full folder selection dialog and banner allowing one-tap selection of all emails in a label or folder across Gmail server.

### Bug fixes
- Fixed launcher icon not updating on circular launcher environments.
- Fixed partial move issue where selecting all only selected visible 50 cached emails, leaving the remaining server emails behind.

routerwarden.notes:
Router Warden 1.1.0 - Smoother updates

### Features
- Update downloads can be paused, resumed from where they stopped, stopped, and retried after a network drop.
- Old update files are deleted automatically after an update installs.

### Bug fixes
- The release signing key is pinned in the repo, so updates built on any machine install over this version.
